entities.summary: Anastasia Vladimirovna Zakharova is a Russian tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of No. 74 in singles, achieved on 16 March 2026, and No. 93 in doubles. Zakharova has won sixteen singles and eight doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit.
